_doc: Trigger-eval fixtures for skill-firing precedence. Each query is labelled with the skill that SHOULD fire (or 'none'). Near-miss negatives are deliberate: queries that sound like they'd fire a skill but shouldn't. Adopted 2026-07-03 from the peer-repo study (anthropics/skills description-optimization loop). Run: node scripts/trigger-eval.mjs (uses local Ollama; non-deterministic, 3 reps). NOT in the CI chain — needs a live model.

descriptions.meta-brain: The router. Use FIRST on ambiguous intent to map a request to the right skill; session start; 'which skill?' / 'what can you do?' questions; a new domain enters. Does NOT itself do the work — it routes.
descriptions.cto-orchestration: Orchestrate a multi-agent build: decompose into briefs, dispatch parallel builders, run reviewer trios, integrate one commit, round-close. Use when the work has 2+ independent slices and a multi-agent runner. Also the lead-CTO tier across projects.
descriptions.cto-brain: Build doctrine for real software: no code without a spec, no implementation without a failing test, model routing, proven/UNPROVEN/blocked honesty. Use on 'build this properly', 'spec this', 'TDD it', or when code is about to be written without a spec or failing test.
descriptions.none: No skill — a trivial edit, a direct factual answer, a one-line shell command, or pure conversation.
